children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Integrated Quantum Technologies Inc.

(OTCQB: IGCRF) (FSE: Y4G1) (the "Company" or "IQT"), an enterprise AI security and infrastructure technology company, announces that it intends to adopt semi-annual financial reporting pursuant to Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933 -
Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers
(the "Blanket Order").

The Blanket Order allows eligible venture issuers to voluntarily transition from quarterly to semi-annual financial reporting, reducing the administrative and financial burden associated with quarterly reporting while maintaining applicable continuous disclosure obligations.
Semi-Annual Reporting

Pursuant to the Blanket Order, the Company will not file interim financial statements or related management's discussion and analysis ("MD&A") for the three-month interim period ending September 30, 2026.

The Company will continue to file interim financial statements and related MD&A for its six-month interim period, as well as annual financial statements and related MD&A, in accordance with applicable securities legislation.
The Company will also continue to comply with its ongoing continuous disclosure obligations, including the timely disclosure of material changes and significant corporate developments.
This news release is being filed pursuant to CSA Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933
Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers
About Integrated Quantum Technologies Inc.

Integrated Quantum Technologies Inc. (IQT) is an enterprise AI security and infrastructure technology company developing technologies designed to enable organizations to securely use sensitive data in artificial intelligence while reducing exposure of the underlying information. The Company's flagship technology, VEIL™ (Vector-Encoded Information Layer), is a privacy-preserving AI security solution designed to protect sensitive information across AI and machine learning environments. IQT's portfolio also includes SecureGuard360™, its cybersecurity platform providing security and monitoring capabilities for enterprise environments.

IQT's broader strategy is focused on building Trust Infrastructure for Enterprise AI at the convergence of artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, enterprise data infrastructure and quantum resilience.
